hero.title: The Indian Agriculture College
hero.summary: TIAC is an agriculture college in Radhapuram, Tirunelveli district, affiliated to TNAU. Established in 2016 under Joshua Educational and Charitable Trust, it focuses on agricultural education and the farming needs of southern Tamil Nadu. Its verified ICAR entry covers the agriculture undergraduate degree.

overview.heading: Agricultural education in southern Tamil Nadu
paragraphs: The Indian Agriculture College is located on the Kavalkinaru–Radhapuram Road in Tirunelveli district. Established in 2016 under Joshua Educational and Charitable Trust, it focuses on agricultural education and the farming needs of southern Tamil Nadu.

Its four-year degree is organised over eight semesters. The course page covers agricultural science alongside surveying, soils, water management and allied subjects. The college also publishes campus material grouped around laboratories, agricultural fields, farms and industrial visits. Applicants can use those resources to identify which practical areas interest them and request the current timetable for field and laboratory learning.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: A four-year, eight-semester TNAU-affiliated agriculture degree. TIAC’s course page includes soils, surveying, water-resource management, animal/poultry management and biotechnology fundamentals.
programmes.eligibility: The course page requires Higher Secondary science and lists OC 55%, BC/BCM 50%, MBC/Denotified Communities 45%, and a pass for SC/ST. The subject table is inconsistently formatted; confirm the exact current combination with TNAU/TIAC.

fees.note: A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

programmes.icar_scope_note: The audited ICAR row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Indian Agriculture College, Radhapuram for 2025-01-27 to 2030-01-26. Printed intake is retained in recognition as historical scope.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to TIAC
admissions.intro: TIAC publishes a four-year, eight-semester agriculture course page and category-based entry thresholds. Its online form is an application starting point; the current TNAU selection channel, deadline and itemised fees should be confirmed before submission.
eligibility_points: Higher Secondary science is required by the course page.
Published category thresholds are OC 55%, BC/BCM 50%, MBC/DNC 45%, and pass for SC/ST; verify the current rule and exact subjects.

steps.title: Read the college application form
steps.text: The official page collects personal, parent and contact information and identifies the agriculture degree.

steps.title: Confirm formal admission requirements
steps.text: Before submitting sensitive records, obtain the current TNAU-linked eligibility, selection channel, deadline and fee schedule from TIAC.

campus.heading: Farm and laboratory material published by TIAC
campus.intro: The campus gallery includes labelled sections for laboratories, agricultural fields, farm activity and industrial visits. A current facilities inventory and detailed participation records were not verified.
practical_learning: The official gallery documents categories for farm activity and industrial visits; ask the college for current cohort schedules.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: TIAC publishes information about the 7.5% government-school reservation route and past supported batches. This is a specific access/support route, not a universal cash scholarship. Confirm current schooling, counselling and funding conditions before claiming support.

schemes.name: 7.5% government-school quota information
schemes.details: The college describes Class 6–12 study in Tamil Nadu government schools and publishes batch counts through 2024–25. Current eligibility and financial coverage require the applicable official admission rules.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: A current TIAC agriculture placement report was not found in the pages read. The college’s stated employability and entrepreneurship objectives describe its educational aims, rather than an independently evidenced employment result.

faqs.question: Can the banner establish the final admission date?
